newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down on unrest in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down on unrest in Karachi.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Tuesday on reports of unrest in Karachi after Tuesday's killings of five workers of the ethnic Mohajir National Movement, dealers said.

"Reports of closure of shops in some areas after yesterday's killings and fears of violence are dampening factors," dealer Ali Asghar said. "PTCL gained on short-covering, but overall investors are sellers at these levels."
The Karachi Stock Exchange index fell 9.41 points, or 0.59 percent, to end at 1,573.11. Losers led gainers 180 to 56. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 0.60 to 36.10 rupees. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
